lead_raw_text:
The tetragonal phase Er4Mn4Si16 (ErMnSi4) crystallizes in space group I-4m2 (No. 119) with 24 atoms per unit cell across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Er and Mn each coordinated by eight Si neighbors, while Si adopts two environments: one with four Er and four Mn neighbors and another with ten Si neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner- and face-sharing between Er and Mn 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing among Si 10-vertex polyhedra.
